start: A friend gets a member's invite link app.mettleup.fit/f/<CODE> on WhatsApp

steps.action: Look at the preview
user_sees: Title '<first name> invites you to <gym>'
Line 'Leave your name and number, and <gym> will call you about joining.'
must_not: The member's surname or number
Another gym's name

steps.action: Open the link
user_sees: Boxes 'Your name', 'Mobile number'
'When would you like to train?' with Morning, Afternoon, Evening, Any time
'Only the gym sees your number. Your friend does not.'
must_not: An install prompt (this page never opens an app)

steps.action: Type a name and a 10-digit number, pick Evening, tap 'Send to the gym'
user_sees: 'Sent. The gym will call you soon.'
'You can close this page now.'
must_not: Two enquiries from one tap
A success message when nothing was saved

steps.action: Tap 'Send to the gym' with an empty name and the number 12345
user_sees: 'Type your name.'
'Type a 10-digit mobile number.'
must_not: The form sent with a bad number

start: Five sends already made today from the same network address (or 5 from this link, or 30 at this gym)

steps.action: Send the form a sixth time
user_sees: 'Too many requests from this link today. Please try again tomorrow.'
must_not: The enquiry saved anyway
A page that says 'Sent'

start: The member who shared the link has left the gym, or the code is wrong

steps.action: Open the link
user_sees: 'This invite link does not work any more'
'Ask your friend to send you a new link.'
must_not: The form shown and then refused only after typing

start: The friend's number is already a member of the gym, or already has an open enquiry there

steps.action: Send the form
user_sees: 'Sent. The gym will call you soon.'
must_not: A second enquiry for the same number
Any words that tell a stranger the number is already a member

start: The friend has sent the form

steps.action: Think about who sees what was typed
user_sees: The name and number go only to that member's gym; MettleUp's page server keeps only a salted one-way code of the network address, deleted after 2 days
must_not: The member who shared the link seeing the number
Another gym getting the enquiry
The number kept on MettleUp's own server

start: A member shares their own invite link from the app (made in the app, another feature)

steps.action: The friend's WhatsApp shows the preview of the shared link
user_sees: '<member first name> invites you to <gym>'
must_not: The member's full name or number in the preview

start: The member has left the gym; a friend opens their old link

steps.action: The friend opens the link
user_sees: 'This invite link does not work any more'
must_not: The enquiry sent to the gym the member left, credited to them

start: A friend sends the form twice from the member's link

steps.action: The friend sends again with the same number while the first enquiry is open
user_sees: 'Sent. The gym will call you soon.' again; the gym still has one enquiry
must_not: Two enquiries or two referrals counted for the member

start: A friend has sent the form from the member's link

steps.action: The member looks for the friend's details
user_sees: Nothing about the friend's number reaches the member
must_not: The friend's number shown to the member anywhere

start: A friend has just sent the form from one of the gym's members' links

steps.action: Open Enquiries in the panel
user_sees: A new open enquiry with the friend's name and +91 number
Interest 'Best time to train: Evening'
Referred by the member's name; follow-up date today
must_not: The enquiry in another gym
The number without its +91
No sign of which member sent the friend

start: The owner is in the panel when the friend sends

steps.action: Look at the bell
user_sees: An alert about a friend who wants to join (exact alert words not read here)
must_not: The alert held back until the next day

start: 30 friend enquiries already came in today across the gym

steps.action: Look at Enquiries after a 31st friend tried
user_sees: No new enquiry for that friend (the friend was told to try tomorrow)
must_not: A half-made enquiry without a name or number

start: The owner closed the friend's enquiry; the same friend sends again from the link

steps.action: Look at Enquiries
user_sees: A new open enquiry for that friend (only an open enquiry stops a new one)
must_not: The send refused, or the closed enquiry silently reopened

start: A friend enquiry is in the gym's Enquiries

steps.action: Check who else can see it
user_sees: Only this gym's owner and desk see the friend's number; the member who shared the link does not
must_not: The number visible to the member or to another gym

start: A friend has sent the form

steps.action: Open Enquiries at the front desk
user_sees: The friend's enquiry with name, number and best time to train
must_not: The enquiry missing on the desk login while the owner sees it

start: The friend's send failed ('Could not send. Check your internet and try again.')

steps.action: Look at Enquiries
user_sees: No new enquiry
must_not: A half-made enquiry with no name or number

start: The desk called the friend and closed the enquiry

steps.action: Close the enquiry, then refresh
user_sees: The enquiry stays closed; the referral for the member stays counted
must_not: The enquiry back as open after a refresh

start: The member's link made on the other address join.mettleup.fit/f/<CODE> (R-539; used once JOIN_HOST is set)

steps.action: Open the link and send the form
user_sees: The same friend page and the same 'Sent. The gym will call you soon.'
must_not: A different page or a refusal on the other address
The enquiry sent to another gym
